item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi 'chad thabs gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni drin chen nyi ma 'od zer gyi phyag len ci lta ba bzhin/ phyogs med ltam dbu'i sprang po tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bam ras chen pos dben gnas bya dur du/ dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su yi ger btab nas/ 'gal 'khrul byung na spros bral ngang du bshags//
